headline: Goldman Sachs slashes South Korean market target amid AI trade shifts
summary: Goldman Sachs cut its forecast for South Korea's Kospi index by 25% due to higher volatility and a reduction in growth multiples for AI stocks.
why: The Kospi index serves as a bellwether for the global semiconductor and artificial intelligence hardware supply chain. Adjustments by major investment banks signal changing institutional sentiment toward tech equities.

impacts.name: Artificial Intelligence
impacts.why: Lowered valuation multiples for AI-linked equities can lead to broad sector de-rating.

why_moved: A reduction in investor willingness to pay high growth multiples for AI stocks forced a downward revision of regional market forecasts.
